description: This file contains utility functions for formatting strings, specifically for converting strings to camelCase and Title Case, used across the application to ensure consistent string rendering in the UI.

methods.name: toCamelCaseName
methods.description: Converts a string to camelCase by handling spaces, underscores, hyphens, collapsing whitespace, and trimming. Returns original if input is not a string.

methods.name: toTitleCaseName
methods.description: Converts a string to Title Case for display, handling delimiters like underscores and hyphens, collapsing spaces, and capitalizing first letters including those after apostrophes. Returns original if input is not a string.
